summary: This note describes Holden, a lake in the municipality of Verran in Trøndelag county, Norway. It gives the lake's location relative to nearby villages, notes a dam at its southern end used to control water for hydroelectric power, and traces its outflow into the Follaelva river, which reaches the Trondheimsfjord at Follafoss.
one_line: Holden is a lake in Verran municipality, Trøndelag county, Norway, dammed for hydroelectric power and drained by the Follaelva river.
key_facts: Holden is a lake in the municipality of Verran in Trøndelag county, Norway.
Holden is located about west of the village of Malm.
Holden is located about north of the village of Follafoss.
The lake has a dam on its southern end to control the water for hydroelectric power.
The lake flows out into the Follaelva river.
The Follaelva river flows into the Trondheimsfjord at the village of Follafoss.
